card.title: Choose the Real Impossibility
card.instruction: Make someone choose which of two incompatible explanations will govern what everyone does next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The sandwiches are floating. Is gravity late for lunch, or has it resigned? We need a serving plan.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The guests arrive in five minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Late means plates underneath. Resigned means string on every sandwich. Which are we doing?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then fetch the deep plates. We may get the whole buffet at once.

mechanism: A makes B choose between temporary and permanent gravity absence by tying each explanation to a serving plan.
confusable: Unlike free-floating surreal discussion, the competing accounts must require different concrete actions.
comparison: Choosing delayed gravity leads to deep catch plates, unlike the size dilemma's full-sized helper and tweezers.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
